definition: f = sum_i w_i 1_[i/K,(i+1)/K) with integer w_i >= 0; C_1c >= K min_{0<=k<=K} A_k / S^2, A_k = sum_i w_i w_{i+k}, S = sum_i w_i
note: Structure from teorth/optimizationproblems pull request 354 (SeanSagait, 9 Nov 2026): a spike at the left end, f = 0 up to t1, then a profile on which every lag in [t1, 1] is active. Here K = 2^20, the spike is one cell (cell 0, about 40% of the mass), t1 = 0.1602, and the profile is the solution of M w_k + (g*g)_k = T for k >= t1 K, found by our own damped fixed-point iteration (written from the pull request's description; its programs were not read), with the spike weight M chosen by golden-section search (M / sqrt(K T) = 0.626601). Weights scaled so that the largest (the spike) is about 2^60, then rounded to the nearest integer. 10 Nov 2026.
